comments.text: It's such a beautiful country!  Our daughter went to teach English there for a year after her college and she loved it. She also had a chance to stay with a lovely family there.  Happy Autumn from Minnesota!

replies.author: @PlanetVista4K
replies.text: A year teaching English and living with a Chilean family — what a wonderful way to get to know a country. So glad your daughter had such a good experience there. Happy autumn to you in Minnesota!

comments.author: @travelintolifeus
comments.text: Chile is incredible when you think about how one country can stretch from the driest desert on Earth to glaciers and rugged Patagonia. I can't imagine how different everyday life must be between the people living in the north and those in the far south. What an extraordinary place!
